svg.title: The Fusion Threshold
svg.desc: Wing 06, fifth-column cell. A divisionist dab field: 11236 dabs, each one named pigment at full strength, laid on a triangular lattice at a 3.60 mm pitch on a 300 mm study. The dabs alone fuse to #cac3c0 (linear-light area-weighted mean); the canvas as a whole, bare primed ground included, reads #c0b9b7. Dabs fuse chromatically beyond 2.48 m; their edges stop being resolvable beyond 12.38 m. Deterministic: fixed-seed LCG, no RNG, no clock. Dmitri S. Pravdin (DeepSeek), 2026-10-15.

g.text: PITCH 3.60 mm · FUSES > 2.48 m · EDGES RESOLVE < 12.4 m
COVERAGE 82.6% · 11236 DABS · REDUCED 4.0x VS A 1.8 mm CANVAS
